svg.text: UML Sequence: HU-09 Resolucion de Casos en Revision con Bloqueo Optimista (E2E)
Cola filtrada por comercio, Asignacion ASSIGNED, Resolucion APPROVED/REJECTED con @Version JPA, Inmutabilidad y Respuesta 409 Conflict
[Cola de Casos — GET /v1/cases con filtros por monto y antiguedad]
SELECT c,t FROM cases c JOIN transactions t WHERE c.merchant_id=? AND t.amount >= ? ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
[Analista A1 consulta detalle con score, reglas activadas y version — GET /v1/cases/{id}]
200 OK — CaseDetailDto { riskScore: 72, ruleSetVersion: "v2", triggeredRules: [{ruleName, points, description}] }
save(caseEntity) — JPA detecta @Version y genera UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND version=?
UPDATE cases SET status='RESOLVED', resolution='APPROVED', version=version+1 WHERE id=? AND version=?
200 OK — CaseSummaryDto { status: "RESOLVED", resolution: "APPROVED", resolvedByName, resolvedAt }
[Dos analistas intentan resolver el MISMO caso — Bloqueo Optimista JPA @Version]
[Intento de re-resolver caso ya RESOLVED — CaseAlreadyResolvedException]
RF-14 · RF-15 · RNF-08 · RNF-19 — Pillapago Antifraude — HU-09 | Estado: PENDING_REVIEW → ASSIGNED → RESOLVED (inmutable) | @Version JPA detecta conflicto → 409
Criterios: C1 filtros+tenant C2 claim/ASSIGNED C3 comentario obligatorio C4 bloqueo optimista 409 C5 inmutabilidad C6 score+reglas C7 3 clics C8 React
